name: logs-anthropic.audit-1.1.0
description: Parse Anthropic compliance audit activities from the Activities API.

remove.description: Removes the fields added by Agentless as metadata, as they can collide with ECS fields.
remove.if: ctx.organization instanceof String && ctx.division instanceof String && ctx.team instanceof String

terminate.description: error message set and no data to process.
terminate.if: ctx.error?.message != null && ctx.message == null && ctx.event?.original == null

rename.description: Renames the original `message` field to `event.original` to store a copy of the original message. The `event.original` field is not touched if the document already has one.

remove.description: The `message` field is no longer required if the document has an `event.original` field.

rename.description: On RBAC role-assignment activities the principal is the user being granted or revoked the role; move the ID into `user.target.id`. Only applies when the API explicitly says `principal_type` is `user`.

On role-assignment activities the target is the user being granted or revoked the role; move the ID into `user.target.id`. Only applies when `target_type` is `user` so we do not clobber non-user targets.
Move the whole actor sub-object under `anthropic.audit.actor`. ECS-mappable members are pulled out of it by subsequent processors.

convert.description: The Compliance API returns the GitHub-assigned webhook ID as a number, but it is stored as a keyword identifier.

append.description: On `role_assignment_granted`/`role_assignment_revoked` activities the `role` field is the role being granted to (or revoked from) the target user. Lift it into `user.target.roles` so it lands on the ECS user target instead of the vendor namespace.

rename.description: Forward-compat safety net: if Anthropic adds a brand-new activity field that is not yet handled by an explicit rename above, dump whatever is left in `json` into `anthropic.audit.metadata` (flattened) so no data is lost. For the documented activity set this rename is a no-op (json is empty at this point).

script.description: This script processor iterates over the whole document to remove fields with null values.

pipeline.name: global@custom
pipeline.description: [Fleet] Global pipeline for all data streams

pipeline.name: logs@custom
pipeline.description: [Fleet] Pipeline for all data streams of type `logs`

pipeline.name: logs-anthropic.integration@custom
pipeline.description: [Fleet] Pipeline for all data streams of type `logs` defined by the `anthropic` integration
